methodology.scope: Retrospective conditional regular-season simulation, not a preseason forecast or independent accuracy validation.
methodology.roster: All observed season-in-team player stints. Game pools use observed appearances; unused DNP reserves are not known.
methodology.ability: Full-season league player totals, including traded stints; inverse accuracy curves with 100-attempt shrinkage. Other measured attributes use GP>=30 / MPG>=20 percentiles.
methodology.defense: Tracked percentage difference shrunk by D_FGA/(D_FGA+200); missing tracking explicitly falls back to neutral 70.
methodology.physique: Height plus weight/10 ranked among measured rotation players; missing weight uses neutral physique 70 and is flagged.
methodology.unknown: offBall, screen, handle and breakDbl are neutral 70 for every player.
methodology.minutes: Season-in-team MPG, renormalized among each game pool to 240 and capped at 48. Observed game minutes are not supplied to the engine.
methodology.roles: Top five rotation targets start, assigned PG/SG/SF/PF/C by height; bench roles use height bands. Not official starting lineups or positions.
methodology.schedule: Observed regular-season games only, 1,230 unique 00225 IDs; NBA Cup championship/play-in/playoffs excluded.
methodology.neutral: Five games have both teams marked away. Official summary supplies designated sides when available; otherwise team ID orders neutral A/B. Neutral games are counted separately, never forced into 41 home / 41 away.
methodology.outcome: Observed scores, wins and margins are stored for comparison only; none are inputs to basketball probabilities.

schedule.sideAssignment: neutral A/B ordered by team ID; NBA summary has no home designation
neutral A/B ordered by team ID; NBA summary has no home designation

fourthProvenance.method: Attack/defense/minute inputs from 366 strictly disjoint pre25 games; cutoff-specific official tracking, conditional later active players/starters, training MPG and population priors. No later observed minute targets.
